{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out invalid age (-1)
valid_converted_customers = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the required numbers
print(f"Number of converted customers (converted == 1): {len(converted_customers)}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age (customer_age != -1): {len(valid_converted_customers)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers with valid age: {mean_age}")"}
